title: VWP Evidence
description: An evidence reference: a source record supporting facts and claims. May point to a package-local file (path) or an external system (externalRef).

path.description: Forward-slash relative path to a package-local evidence file.

derivedFrom.description: Evidence id this object was mechanically derived from (e.g. a text extraction of a PDF, an OCR of a screenshot). The original remains the authoritative source; the derived layer exists so facts can anchor into verifiable text.

transform.description: How the derived evidence was produced from its source. Required in spirit whenever derivedFrom is set, so the derivation is reproducible and challengeable.
